recipe.name: h3-three-pose-20260927-v2-reference-defaults

compute_capability.note: Existing 8.9–9.x range retained. Exact RTX 3090 sm86 is separately qualified by qualified_gpu_profiles; other Ampere and Blackwell are not admitted by that exception.
